constraints.name: day_records_session_statuses_valid
constraints.definition:
CHECK (
CASE
    WHEN session_statuses IS NULL THEN true
    WHEN jsonb_typeof(session_statuses) <> 'array'::text THEN false
    ELSE COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(session_statuses) = 2 AND ((session_statuses -> 0) -> 'session'::text) = '1'::jsonb AND ((session_statuses -> 1) -> 'session'::text) = '2'::jsonb AND (((session_statuses -> 0) ->> 'status'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['P'::text, 'A'::text, 'O'::text])) AND (((session_statuses -> 1) ->> 'status'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['P'::text, 'A'::text, 'O'::text])), false)
END) NOT VALID

constraints.name: day_records_session_statuses_valid
constraints.definition:
CHECK (
CASE
    WHEN session_statuses IS NULL THEN true
    WHEN jsonb_typeof(session_statuses) <> 'array'::text THEN false
    ELSE COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(session_statuses) = 2 AND ((session_statuses -> 0) -> 'session'::text) = '1'::jsonb AND ((session_statuses -> 1) -> 'session'::text) = '2'::jsonb AND (((session_statuses -> 0) ->> 'status'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['P'::text, 'A'::text, 'O'::text])) AND (((session_statuses -> 1) ->> 'status'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['P'::text, 'A'::text, 'O'::text])), false)
END) NOT VALID
